# Version 4.159.0
> **Programmable meshes and image testing** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.159.0-rc.1.26567.13)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.159.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/15.0.0.100/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.159 previews programmable GPU meshes and an experimental image-comparison package on Skia m159. The line also improves runtime-effect uniform initialization, Windows image-decoder recovery, Apple device frameworks and filtered texture sampling. WebAssembly requires .NET 9 or later, and Linux x86 native assets are removed; non-WebAssembly .NET 8 support remains unchanged.

## Breaking Changes

- **Move WebAssembly applications to .NET 9 or later** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp no longer provide .NET 8 WebAssembly native assets, and packaged targets reject unsupported WASM frameworks. Retarget WASM applications to .NET 9 or later and use the runtime-matched archives rather than substituting newer archives into .NET 8. Non-WebAssembly .NET 8 support is unchanged. ([#5700](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5700))
- **Replace Linux x86 deployments** — Linux x86 native builds and NuGet package entries are removed. Applications relying on those assets must move to a supported Linux architecture, such as x64, before adopting this line's updated packages. ([#5784](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5784))

## Engine

- **Skia m159** — Updates the native renderer with WebAssembly SIMD CPU rasterization, Windows font-loading improvements and image/rendering correctness fixes, then incorporates subsequent m159 upstream fixes. The milestone transition itself leaves C API exports and public managed signatures unchanged. ([#5685](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5685), [#5841](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5841))

## API Surface

- **Programmable GPU meshes** — SKMesh specifications compile SkSL vertex and fragment programs for indexed or non-indexed drawing through SKCanvas.DrawMesh, with builders, uniforms, children and CPU or Ganesh GPU buffers. Built meshes retain the native references they need after input wrappers are disposed. Drawing requires a GPU-backed surface; raster drawing is a no-op. ([#5760](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5760))
- **Experimental image comparisons** — The separate SkiaSharp.Testing package adds SKImageComparison for images, bitmaps and pixmaps, with channel tolerances, masks, mismatch budgets, MAE/RMS/PSNR metrics and five difference-image styles. The assembly is experimental under SKIA4001. Results retain no native handles; generated difference images are independent caller-owned SKImage instances. ([#5293](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5293))

## Bug Fixes

- **Uniform initialization and reset** — New SKRuntimeEffectUniforms buffers start zeroed rather than containing leftover memory. Reset clears the existing buffer in place without allocating a replacement, including uniforms used by mesh builders. — ❤️ [@taublast](https://github.com/taublast) ([#5843](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5843))
- **Windows image-decoding recovery** — Windows x64 clang builds avoid crashes when libjpeg or libpng recovers from decoding errors, including lazy non-JPEG PDF images and malformed JPEGs passed to SKCodec.Create. CFG remains enabled; arm64, x86 and MSVC builds are unchanged. — ❤️ [@SimonCropp](https://github.com/SimonCropp) ([#5827](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5827))
- **Trim-safe MAUI view binding** — MAUI SKGLView uses a typed Window binding to eliminate the warning caused by a runtime string-path binding in trimmed applications. The proxy-window binding behavior is unchanged. — ❤️ [@bhall-ctre](https://github.com/bhall-ctre) ([#5320](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5320))
- **Texture sampling and CPU blur selection** — Ganesh uses an inward inset for filtered texture-subset edges, avoiding undefined exterior texels; this does not change CPU or Graphite sampling. Tizen now applies its intended CPU blur setting to Skia itself, selecting the existing ThreeBoxApprox/Tent path instead of the shader-based Gaussian candidate. Texture-edge and Tizen blur pixels may differ. ([#5679](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5679))
- **Glyphs, caches and Vulkan failures** — Mask-filtered glyphs use reloaded paths, formats and full plane strides, clearing incompatible masks safely. Image-filter cache equality matches hashing. Imagination Vulkan descriptor pools are deliberately abandoned after affected out-of-memory errors rather than destroyed, trading cleanup for driver safety. ([#5741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5741), [#5769](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5769))
- **Apple device framework packaging** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp iOS/tvOS device frameworks contain only arm64 device binaries and matching metadata, avoiding simulator slices that could cause App Store validation failure ITMS-90087. Simulator frameworks and symbols retain their x86_64 and arm64 slices. — ❤️ [@kdpkke](https://github.com/kdpkke) ([#5649](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5649))

## HarfBuzzSharp 15.0.0.100

HarfBuzzSharp package revision 15.0.0.100 retains native HarfBuzz 15.0.0. The collected changes remove .NET 8 WebAssembly and Linux x86 native assets and correct iOS/tvOS device frameworks while preserving simulator slices.

## Release Candidate 1 (November 17, 2026)

Release Candidate 1 adds programmable GPU mesh drawing and corrects SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp Apple device frameworks. It also includes glyph-rendering, image-filter cache and Imagination Vulkan allocation fixes.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.159.0-preview.1.26563.22...v4.159.0-rc.1.26567.13)

## Preview 1 (November 14, 2026)

Preview 1 introduces Skia m159 with WebAssembly SIMD rasterization and Windows font-loading improvements. WebAssembly now requires .NET 9 or later; non-WebAssembly .NET 8 support is unchanged.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.158.0-rc.1.26567.14...v4.159.0-preview.1.26563.22)
